name: Agra
tagline: Home of the Taj Mahal and Mughal majesty
description: Agra is a city of monuments, palaces, and mausoleums on the banks of the Yamuna River. Known worldwide for the Taj Mahal — a sublime white marble monument to love — it also boasts the colossal Agra Fort and the ancient ghost city of Fatehpur Sikri.
bestTimeToVisit: November to March. Cool winter days are ideal for walking around marble complexes. Avoid May–June when heat is extreme.

name: Jaipur
tagline: The Pink City of palatial forts and royal heritage
description: Jaipur, Rajasthan's capital, is famed for its majestic pink-painted sandstone architecture, astronomical observatories, and sprawling hill forts. Explore the intricate facade of Hawa Mahal, the grand courtyards of City Palace, and the formidable walls of Amer Fort.
bestTimeToVisit: November to March. The weather is perfect for sightseeing and enjoying outdoor cultural festivals. March hosts the famous Elephant Festival.

name: Varanasi
tagline: The eternal city where life, death, and the Ganges meet
description: Varanasi is among the oldest continuously inhabited cities on Earth and Hinduism's holiest pilgrimage site. Witness the hypnotic Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat, take a dawn boat ride past 88 ghats, and get lost in labyrinthine alleyways fragrant with marigolds and incense.
bestTimeToVisit: October to March. Dev Deepawali (November) is extraordinary — 1 million diyas illuminate every ghat. Summer is brutal; monsoon floods the lower ghats.

name: Udaipur
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Udaipur
description: The City of Lakes, known for its romantic palaces and shimmering waters.

name: Jodhpur
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Jodhpur
description: The Blue City, dominated by the mighty Mehrangarh Fort.

name: Jaisalmer
tagline: The Golden City rising from Thar's endless sands
description: Jaisalmer is a living fairy tale carved from golden sandstone in the heart of the Thar Desert. Its 12th-century fort — one of the world's few inhabited forts — rises like a mirage above the dunes. Camel safaris, havelis, and a sky blazing with stars await.
bestTimeToVisit: October to March. The Desert Festival in February is unmissable — folk music, camel races, and turban-tying competitions. Summers exceed 45°C; avoid unless you must.

name: Pushkar
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Pushkar
description: A sacred town famous for its Brahma Temple and colorful camel fair.

name: Bikaner
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Bikaner
description: A desert city known for its well-preserved Junagarh Fort.

name: New Delhi
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in New Delhi
description: The bustling capital city, blending ancient history with modern life.

name: Amritsar
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Amritsar
description: Home to the golden Harmandir Sahib (Golden Temple).

name: Chandigarh
tagline: Explore the charm of Chandigarh
description: India's first planned city, famous for its modernist architecture.

name: Shimla
tagline: The summer capital of British India amidst snow-capped peaks
description: Set in the Himalayan foothills, Shimla is a picturesque mountain city with a rich colonial history, marked by mock-Tudor and Victorian buildings. Stroll along the pedestrian-only Mall Road, take the historic Kalka-Shimla toy train, and enjoy panoramic views of pine-clad hills.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June is pleasant and sunny. Late December to February is perfect if you want to experience snow and go ice-skating.
funActivities: Ice Skating at the Open-air Rink

name: Manali
tagline: Gateway to Solang Valley and high-altitude mountain thrills
description: Manali is India's prime hub for adventure sport and Himalayan treks, situated on the banks of the Beas River. From snowboarding and skiing in Solang Valley to paragliding, river rafting, and crossing the spectacular Atal Tunnel to Lahaul, Manali is a playground for thrill-seekers.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June for summer activities and lush valleys. October to February for skiing and fresh snow. Avoid July–August due to landslides and heavy rain.

name: Dharamshala
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Dharamshala
description: The home of the Dalai Lama, set against the Dhauladhar range.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Leh
tagline: Explore the charm of Leh
description: A high-altitude desert paradise with breathtaking monasteries.

name: Srinagar
tagline: Explore the charm of Srinagar
description: Famous for its serene Dal Lake and floating gardens.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Rishikesh
tagline: The yoga capital of the world on the holy Ganges
description: Rishikesh is where the sacred Ganges flows out of the Himalayas into the plains. Famed as the spiritual hub where the Beatles came to study meditation, it now blends ashram yoga retreats with high-adrenaline white water rafting, giant swings, and bungee jumping.
bestTimeToVisit: September to November and March to May. Rafting is closed during the July–August monsoon. Winters are chilly but pleasant.

name: Haridwar
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Haridwar
description: One of the seven holiest places for Hindus, on the banks of the Ganges.

name: Nainital
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Nainital
description: A charming hill station built around a beautiful emerald lake.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Mussoorie
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Mussoorie
description: The Queen of the Hills, offering panoramic Himalayan views.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Panaji
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Panaji
description: The heart of Goa, famous for its beautiful beaches and Portuguese culture.

name: Mumbai
tagline: Explore the charm of Mumbai
description: The City of Dreams, featuring Bollywood, marine drives, and colonial history.

name: Pune
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Pune
description: A vibrant cultural hub with rich Maratha history.

name: Aurangabad
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Aurangabad
description: Gateway to the stunning Ajanta and Ellora cave temples.

name: Lonavala
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Lonavala
description: A picturesque hill station with lush valleys and ancient caves.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Mahabaleshwar
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Mahabaleshwar
description: Famous for its strawberries, viewpoints, and old colonial retreats.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Nashik
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Nashik
description: One of India's holy cities, surrounded by vineyards and temples.

name: Ahmedabad
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Ahmedabad
description: The Manchester of India, known for its textile mills and Sabarmati Ashram.

name: Vadodara
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Vadodara
description: A royal city with exquisite palaces and the famous Laxmi Vilas Palace.

name: Surat
tagline: Explore the charm of Surat
description: A diamond polishing hub with a vibrant culinary scene.

name: Dwarka
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Dwarka
description: An ancient city of Lord Krishna, located at the western tip of India.

name: Somnath
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Somnath
description: Home to the first Jyotirlinga temple, with a stunning coastal backdrop.

name: Bhopal
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Bhopal
description: The City of Lakes, known for its beautiful mosques and greenery.

name: Indore
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Indore
description: A commercial capital famous for its food streets and majestic palaces.

name: Gwalior
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Gwalior
description: A historic city dominated by the massive Gwalior Fort.

name: Khajuraho
tagline: Stunning medieval temples with exquisite stone carvings
description: Khajuraho is renowned for its UNESCO-listed group of Hindu and Jain temples built by the Chandela dynasty. The temples are famous for their architectural genius and intricate, sensuous stone carvings depicting life, love, and spiritual celebration in medieval India.
bestTimeToVisit: October to March. The Khajuraho Dance Festival in February showcases classical dances against the backdrop of illuminated temples.

name: Pachmarhi
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Pachmarhi
description: The only hill station in MP, surrounded by waterfalls and dense forests.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Kolkata
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Kolkata
description: The City of Joy, known for its colonial architecture, literature, and sweets.

name: Darjeeling
tagline: Tea gardens and Himalayan panoramas at dawn
description: Perched at 2,050m in the foothills of the Himalayas, Darjeeling is famous for its muscatel tea, the UNESCO-listed toy train, and the jaw-dropping view of Kanchenjunga — the world's third-highest peak — at sunrise from Tiger Hill.
bestTimeToVisit: March to May for blooming rhododendrons and clear Himalayan views. October to December post-monsoon is also superb. June–September monsoon brings mist, leeches, and closed roads.

name: Gangtok
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Gangtok
description: A beautiful mountain city blending Buddhist culture with modern vibes.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Shillong
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Shillong
description: The Scotland of the East, famous for its living root bridges.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Kaziranga
tagline: Explore the charm of Kaziranga
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site famous for the one-horned rhinoceros.

name: Puri
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Puri
description: A coastal city housing the sacred Jagannath Temple.

name: Bhubaneswar
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Bhubaneswar
description: The Temple City of India with exquisite ancient Kalinga architecture.

name: Konark
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Konark
description: Famous for the 13th-century Sun Temple, a masterpiece of architecture.

name: Bodh Gaya
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Bodh Gaya
description: The most sacred place for Buddhists, where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment.

name: Patna
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Patna
description: An ancient city along the Ganges, rich in Jain and Buddhist heritage.

name: Ranchi
tagline: Explore the charm of Ranchi
description: The scenic capital with numerous waterfalls and lush greenery.

name: Chennai
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Chennai
description: A vibrant cultural hub famous for its beaches, temples, and South Indian cuisine.

name: Madurai
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Madurai
description: The city of the magnificent Meenakshi Temple and rich Dravidian history.

name: Kanyakumari
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Kanyakumari
description: The southernmost tip of India, where the Arabian Sea and Bay of Bengal meet.

name: Ooty
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Ooty
description: The Queen of Nilgiris, famous for its rolling tea gardens and toy train.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Kodaikanal
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Kodaikanal
description: The Princess of Hills, adorned with beautiful lakes and pine forests.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Mahabalipuram
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Mahabalipuram
description: A coastal town with stunning rock-cut monuments and ancient temples.

name: Rameswaram
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Rameswaram
description: An island city famous for its Ramanathaswamy Temple and Pamban Bridge.

name: Bangalore
tagline: Explore the charm of Bangalore
description: India's Silicon Valley, known for its pleasant weather and buzzing nightlife.

name: Mysore
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Mysore
description: The City of Palaces, home to the grand Mysore Palace and Dussehra festival.

name: Hampi
tagline: Lost empire of the Vijayanagara kings among giant boulders
description: Hampi is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Asia's greatest ruins — a surreal landscape of 1,600 granite temples, royal enclosures, and elephant stables scattered across a boulder-strewn moonscape in Karnataka. Rent a bicycle and lose yourself for days.
bestTimeToVisit: October to February. Winters are warm and dry, perfect for cycling between ruins. Summer (Mar–May) is scorching; July–September monsoon is beautiful but some sites get muddy.

name: Gokarna
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Gokarna
description: A calm coastal temple town with pristine, serene beaches.

name: Coorg
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Coorg
description: The Scotland of India, known for its misty hills and coffee plantations.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Hyderabad
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Hyderabad
description: The City of Pearls, famous for its Charminar, biryani, and IT hubs.

name: Visakhapatnam
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Visakhapatnam
description: A scenic coastal city nestled between the Eastern Ghats and the sea.

name: Tirupati
tagline: Seek peace and spiritual energy in Tirupati
description: Home to the world-famous Sri Venkateswara Temple on the hills.

name: Trivandrum
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Trivandrum
description: The capital of Kerala, known for its beaches and the Padmanabhaswamy Temple.

name: Munnar
tagline: Rolling tea gardens and misty mountain peaks
description: Munnar is a breathtaking hill station in Kerala's Western Ghats. Known for its carpeted green tea plantations, winding roads, mist-draped peaks, and protected wildlife reserves, it is a serene haven for nature lovers and tea aficionados.
bestTimeToVisit: September to May. Summers are mild and refreshing, while winters offer misty mornings. Monsoons (June–August) are incredibly lush but have heavy downpours.

name: Alleppey
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Alleppey
description: The Venice of the East, famous for its tranquil houseboat cruises.

name: Cochin
tagline: Walk through history and architectural grandeur in Cochin
description: A port city with a rich mix of Dutch, Portuguese, and Indian cultures.

name: Wayanad
tagline: Serene heights and fresh mountain air in Wayanad
description: A lush green district with wildlife sanctuaries and stunning waterfalls.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June (Summer) and October to February (Snow)

name: Port Blair
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Port Blair
description: The gateway to the Andaman Islands with pristine beaches and cellular jail.

name: Diu
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Diu
description: A tranquil island with Portuguese architecture and calm beaches.

name: Daman
tagline: Unwind by the golden coasts of Daman
description: A coastal city with quiet beaches and old Portuguese colonial churches.
